nodes.label: Baseline production schema snapshot (squashed remote dump)
Charge-payment-allocation money core (ledger, payments, applications, P&L)
FIFO payment-to-charge allocation engine
Four coexisting generations of the allocation algorithm
Unique constraints are the idempotency mechanism for money postings
Prefixed reference-key namespace (vexp:, service:, plate:, dispose:, FIN-UPFRONT:) for idempotent P&L
Per-vehicle profit & loss posting (Revenue/Cost sides)
Recurring rental charge generation by period type (Daily/Weekly/Monthly)
Auto-apply held customer credit the moment a new charge lands
Website booking pre-authorisation with manual admin approval
Rationale: Stripe capture/cancel must run in an edge function before the SQL function is called
Future-dated (scheduled) Stripe refund pipeline
Customer blocking plus cross-customer identity blacklist
Rationale: email addresses are deliberately no longer added to the blocklist
Veriff-provider identity verification records
Anonymous pre-signup verification claim is one-way (NULL customer_id can only be filled, never re-pointed)
Row-level tenant isolation via get_user_tenant_id()/is_super_admin()
Super-admin tenant impersonation through JWT user_metadata.impersonated_tenant_id
Blanket USING(true) policies coexist with tenant_isolation policies on the same tables
Super admin implies tenant_id IS NULL (enforced by CHECK)
tenant_id retrofitted as a nullable column onto every business table
Pre-Supabase-Auth bcrypt username/password login
Dead functions bound to a retired data model (ledger, p_l, payments.type, customers.balance)
Parameter shadowing makes the balance update match every customer row
Daily dunning reminder generation with credit suppression
Two overlapping generations of reminder storage (reminder_events vs reminders)
Acquisition cost capitalisation: purchase price vs full finance contract total upfront
Vehicle disposal gain/loss accounting against book cost
Vehicle availability kept in sync with rental status
Several independent writers flip vehicles.status (trigger, approve, reject, cascade delete, disposal)
Schema-introspecting cascade delete for rentals (information_schema-driven, no hardcoded child list)
Branding/theme columns duplicated between tenants and org_settings
DocuSign-era e-signature columns on rentals (envelope id, document_status)
Reporting and CSV-export view layer (aging, statements, P&L, exports)
view_pl_consolidated matches 'InitialFees' but the CHECK only allows 'Initial Fees'
view_rentals_export matches lowercase 'charge'/'initial_fee' that the data never uses
supabase_realtime publication carries only the plates table
Settings change audit trail keyed on the app.current_user session variable
Initial fees are company revenue only and never become customer debt
Balance semantics: only due charges count, yielding Settled / In Debt / In Credit
Insurance policy expiry status recalculation and overlap detection
Fine liability decides posting: Business fines cost immediately, Customer fines wait for admin action
Global and per-vehicle blocked date ranges for availability
Multi-tenant CMS with anonymous read restricted to published pages
Exactly one active agreement template per tenant (partial unique index)
ledger_entries - single source of truth for customer charges and debt
payments - money received, carrying Stripe pre-auth, verification and refund state
payment_applications - the payment-to-charge allocation join
pnl_entries - per-vehicle revenue and cost postings
rentals - rental agreements and their lifecycle status
vehicles - fleet assets with acquisition, finance and disposal data
customers - renters, including block state and identity numbers
tenants - rental operators, their branding and operational limits
app_users - portal staff, their role and tenant binding
blocked_identities - licence/ID/passport blacklist shared across customers
identity_verifications - Veriff sessions and extracted document data
reminder_events - queued/delivered dunning reminders, unique per charge and type
org_settings - per-org operational and branding settings, audited on change
fines - PCN/speeding fines with Customer vs Business liability
insurance_policies - customer/vehicle cover with derived expiry status
payment_apply_fifo_v2 - current FIFO allocator, allocates across all open charges
apply_payment_fully - allocator that also generates the next charge when credit remains
apply_payments_to_charges - batch allocator restricted to charges already due
process_payment_transaction - JSONB-returning payment posting entry point
rental_create_charge - upsert of one charge per rental+due_date
generate_next_rental_charge - advances the billing cycle by rental_period_type
generate_first_charge_for_rental - status-agnostic first charge for the booking flow
trigger_auto_allocate_payments - fires on every new rental charge to consume credit
approve_booking_payment - marks capture done, activates rental, rents the vehicle
reject_booking_payment - cancels the hold and the rental, leaving the vehicle available
get_expiring_bookings - pre-auth holds expiring within two days
get_refunds_due_today - work queue for the scheduled-refund job
block_customer - blocks a customer and harvests every identity number it can find
get_user_tenant_id - tenant resolver honouring impersonation
get_effective_tenant_id - same resolver without impersonation support
is_super_admin - RLS escape hatch across all tenants
generate_daily_reminders - schedule-driven dunning message generator
pnl_post_acquisition - capitalises purchase price or whole finance contract
dispose_vehicle - books disposal gain or loss against book cost
handle_vehicle_expense_pnl - maps expense categories onto P&L categories
update_vehicle_status_on_rental_change - rental status drives vehicle availability
delete_rental_cascade - discovers child tables from information_schema at runtime
update_customer_balance - legacy balance writer against a column that no longer exists
apply_payment - legacy allocator against the retired payments.type/status model
app_login - bcrypt username/password login against a users table not in this schema
get_customer_balance_with_status - net position and Settled/In Debt/In Credit label
recalculate_insurance_status - derives Active/ExpiringSoon/Expired from dates
trigger_create_fine_charge - posts cost only for Business-liability fines
audit_settings_changes - generic jsonb diff audit trigger
